projects.name: Sediul COLOR METAL
sourceFiles: Referencia fuzetek/Ref fuzet Alu/WhatsApp Image 2025-04-25 at 14.25.55.jpeg
projects.note: Company headquarters with green expanded-aluminium façade ('COLOR METAL 20'), included in the aluminium reference booklet. Photographs supplied by COLOR METAL for the whole site (13 Nov 2026, marketing share 'M:/COLOR METAL HEADQUARTER BUILDING PHOTOS', 26 files): copies of a curated selection are kept in work/supplementary/sediu-color-metal (1-office: ground photos 3.jpg, 2.jpg, 1.jpg, 4.jpg of Aug 2026 and 3.jpeg, 1.jpeg of spring 2026; 2-drone: the re-graded Drón2/2, 4, 1, 3 and DJI_0557, DJI_0554 of Nov 2025; 3-second-building: DSC04961, 04951, 04957, 04963). Left out as duplicates: 2.jpeg (= the booklet photo above), 4.jpeg (= 1.jpeg), DJI_0550–0553/0555/0556 (grey originals of the Drón2 re-grades or near-identical views), DSC04956/04965 (near-identical to 04951/04963).
